summary: Full backend + frontend testing for Engraved Word meeting MVP. 13/13 pytest backend tests pass (auth register/login/me with bearer + cookie, meetings CRUD + auth guards, WebSocket signaling with 2 peers including welcome/participants, peer-joined broadcast, chat broadcast, peer-left on disconnect). Frontend E2E: landing gates create-meeting-btn to /login when logged out, register creates account and returns home showing logout, create-meeting navigates to /j/{code} lobby, lobby renders name+copy link+join even when camera permission is denied (headless), join navigates to /room/{code}, meeting room renders local video tile (green fallback since no camera), top bar with room code + Live timer, and control bar with mic/cam/screen/chat/participants/copy/leave all clickable. Chat and Participants side panels toggle correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Cookie is set with SameSite=None; Secure which is correct for cross-site preview; only works over HTTPS. localStorage fallback (ew_token) covers other cases - good.
seed_admin properly upserts password if it changes. bcrypt hash format is $2b$ (correct).
WebSocket auth: signaling endpoint /api/ws/{code} is unauthenticated - by design (guests join with just a name). This matches the spec but any attacker with the code can join; acceptable for MVP.
No brute-force lockout on login (spec not required for MVP but flagged from auth playbook).
seed_data_creation: Registered ad-hoc host e2e_*@example.com during frontend run; test_*@engravedword.com during pytest run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py; run with `python -m pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py -o addopts=''`. WebSocket test relies on ordering (needs to run after test_create_meeting_ok in same session). Frontend uses data-testid selectors matching spec exactly.
